messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users encounter minor but persistent problems with workflows, onboarding, and system usage that slow them down. These issues aren't critical but hinder efficiency and need attention to improve daily operations.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4134",
   "similarity": 0.05,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.\", \"id\": 4134, \"name\": \"Task list improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4130",
   "similarity": 0.034,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.\", \"id\": 4130, \"name\": \"Payment history improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4132",
   "similarity": 0.034,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now displays a chronological activity timeline for each claim, showing key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface to improve case tracking and accountability.\", \"id\": 4132, \"name\": \"Activity timeline display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "02667fa8-ad6a-5f71-85e0-ab7f6a88ad86",
   "similarity": 0.032,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"02667fa8-ad6a-5f71-85e0-ab7f6a88ad86\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Summer release notes\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Summer release notes\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater's Summer release notes detail new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements for the claims processing system, ensuring smoother workflows and enhanced user experience.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater's Summer release notes detail new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements for the claims processing system, ensuring smoother workflows and enhanced user experience.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"rich_text\"}, \""
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "30cf8382-0725-5e19-b883-945ae35bebcd",
   "similarity": 0.031,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"30cf8382-0725-5e19-b883-945ae35bebcd\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Supplier directory\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Supplier directory\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"A searchable directory within Keelwater that lets users find and manage supplier information, including contact details, contract status, and claim history, streamlining collaboration and compliance tracking.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"A searchable directory within Keelwater that lets users find and manage supplier information, including contact details, contract status, and claim history, streamlining collaboration and compliance tracking.\"},"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The opportunity claims users face \"minor but persistent problems with workflows, onboarding, and system usage\" that hinder daily efficiency. I checked the five most similar items: the closest match, Shortcut story 4134 \"Task list improvements\" (similarity 0.05), touches workflow efficiency but is started and not completed, so it is not shipped. The two completed stories, 4130 \"Payment history improvements\" and 4132 \"Activity timeline display\" (both completed 2026-09-15), solve different problems (payment reconciliation and claim event tracking), and the Notion pages (\"Summer release notes\" and \"Supplier directory\") are release notes and a directory feature that do not cover this generic onboarding/system-usage friction. No completed story solves the same core problem and no roadmap item covers it, so the problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
